newsitem.title: USA: Albemarle Corp Q1 share declines.
newsitem.headline: Albemarle Corp Q1 share declines.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Results for 1996 included an after-tax gain of $94.4 million, or $1.41 per share, from the March 1, 1996, sale of the alpha olefins, poly alpha olefins and synthetic alcohols businesses and two months operating earnings of the Olefins Business prior to the sale.
Excluding the 1996 special gain, first quarter operating earnings, including two months operating earnings of the Olefins Business, were $21.2 million, or 32 cents per share.
The decline in average shares in 1997 versus 1996 reflects the impact of the company's repurchases of its common stock during the second and third quarters of 1996.
